test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion's logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some glass are pink.

All pink are bags.

Some bags are flowers.

**Conclusion I:** Some pink are glass.

**Conclusion II:** Some flowers are bags.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9cd0db2b0bc9f3f9f60d6a008be9b8d5cabfb316f89e1bc8db2f9c9423639e2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pink are glass → Follow (As, some glass are pink. So, as some part of glass is common with pink therefore it is definitely true.)

II. Some flowers are bags → Follow (As, some bags are flowers. So, as some part of bags is common with flower therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
